articles.title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
articles.description: No reason has been given for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident last week when police were alerted to "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.

articles.title: Andrew takes legal action over search warrants before his arrest
articles.description: Mountbatten-Windsor's lawyers are challenging warrants used relating to his arrest in February on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

articles.title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
articles.description: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.

articles.title: Watch: How the eviction of an elderly resident in Madrid led to a snap election
articles.description: A series of measures to tackle the housing crisis were defeated in parliament on Friday
